name: Draft
description: SPES officer creates the participation record and adds project description, location, documents, survey questions, and participation method.

name: GIS linking
description: GIS data steward links the record to a canonical place ID. The system stores all known aliases from Estate, Planning, GIS, and project records.

name: Internal review
description: Related departments review project facts, legal text, maps, and survey questions.

name: Active
description: The record appears publicly on the map and list. The public submits responses. Survey mode is either anonymous or eFaas verified.

name: Closed
description: Submission window ends. Public response collection stops.

name: Moderation and cleanup
description: Moderator removes spam, abusive content, duplicates, and invalid entries. Raw data is preserved separately; only cleaned data is shown publicly.

name: SPES review
description: Socio-Environmental Planning Section reviews cleaned results and prepares the conclusion and response matrix.

name: Decision published
description: Final decision appears on the public portal. Charts, summary data, and cleaned datasets become visible.

name: Archived
description: The record remains searchable as a completed participation record.
